problem_statement: question as it relates to court-awarded attorney fees. Thus, State Personnel Board is not controlling here. A division of this court has held that an award granting attorney fees, but not determining the amount, is not a final judgment. Axtell v. Park School District R-3, 962 P.2d 319 (Colo.App.1998).
